CampusGo Specification 1. Executive Summary & Architecture

1. Executive Summary & System Scope

Campus transportation across large university campuses such as Obafemi Awolowo University faces systemic challenges: students often do not know whether a bus is loading at Campus Gate or SUB Car Park, when the last vehicle departed, or whether availability records are fresh. Concurrently, tricycle charters have traditionally been coordinated via informal, unverified roadside negotiations.

CampusGo bridges this operational gap by introducing a lightweight, real-time coordination layer that complements the university's physical ticket system without requiring expensive GPS hardware.

1.1 Core Boundaries & Guarantees

Complementary Ticketing Model (FR-23) Guaranteed Boundary

CampusGo explicitly serves as an availability and coordination tool. It does not claim to replace physical ticketing booths or collect bus ticket fares. Students are clearly informed that bus tickets continue to be acquired through established park ticket stands.

Honest Availability & Zero GPS Pretense (FR-24) Accuracy Principle

Rather than rendering unreliable, simulated GPS map pins, CampusGo reports honest operational statuses backed by verifiable timestamps and freshness indicators (e.g., "Confirmed 4 mins ago"). Records older than 2 hours are automatically flagged as Unconfirmed (FR-09).

Unified Shared-Fleet Architecture (FR-14) Fleet Continuity

Vehicles and drivers belong to a single university-wide fleet pool that moves dynamically between Campus Gate Car Park and SUB Car Park. Moving between parks does not create duplicate driver records or split inventory.

CampusGo Specification 2. Student Portal Functionalities

2. Student Portal Core Functionalities

The student portal is crafted with a mobile-first, Bolt-inspired design language allowing students to check live availability in seconds and submit on-demand tricycle charter requests with upfront price estimates.

2.1 Verified Bus Availability Monitor (FR-20, FR-21, FR-22)

  • Dual-Park Live Overview: Side-by-side availability counters for Campus Gate Car Park and Student Union Building (SUB) Car Park.
  • Color-Coded Freshness Badges: Green (Confirmed < 30 mins ago), Amber (Aging > 1 hour), and Muted (Unconfirmed > 2 hours).
  • Fleet State Breakdown: Live counts of buses currently loading, buses en route between parks, and standby vehicles.
https://campus-go-7fcb.onrender.com (Student Home View)
Screenshot 1: Student Live Bus Availability Interface featuring live park counters, freshness badges, and quick tricycle charter button.

2.2 Bolt-Inspired Tricycle Chartering Workflow (FR-25 to FR-30)

Intelligent Campus Location Selector (FR-25) Smart Routing

Includes over 18 pre-configured campus landmarks across academic and residential zones (Senate Building, Spider House, Moremi Hall, PG College, Health Sciences, E.T.F. Hall, Fajuyi, Awolowo Hall).

Transparent Fare Estimation & Live Status (FR-26, FR-28) Fare Predictability

Calculates estimated fare quotes based on standard distance bands (₦300 - ₦600) and displays live lifecycle statuses: Pending → Accepted → In Progress → Completed. Students see driver identity, phone call shortcut, and vehicle registration upon acceptance.

CampusGo Specification 3. Driver Portal Functionalities

3. Driver Portal Core Functionalities

The driver interface provides licensed bus and tricycle operators with a distraction-free operational dashboard to control their shift availability, receive charter dispatches, and log trip progress.

3.1 Shift & Operational State Management (FR-05 to FR-09)

Status Field Permitted Values Operational Implication
Shift Status (FR-08) Not Checked In | On Duty | Shift Ended Tracks daily work shift lifecycle. Driver cannot receive orders until checked in.
Operational Status (FR-07) Available | On Trip | On Break | Unconfirmed Indicates immediate passenger readiness. Taking a break pauses dispatch without ending shift.
Stale Detection (FR-09) Auto-triggered after 2 hours without update Flags driver as unconfirmed to prevent misleading students, without forcefully ending shift.
https://campus-go-7fcb.onrender.com (Driver Shift View)
Screenshot 3: Driver Shift Management dashboard with one-touch shift check-in, operational status toggles, and live incoming requests stream.

3.2 Real-Time Charter Dispatch Stream (FR-27 to FR-29)

  • Incoming Request Cards: Displays student pickup point, target destination, passenger name, and estimated fare earnings.
  • One-Tap Accept / Decline: Accepting a request locks the booking immediately, preventing double-assignment (FR-28).
  • Active Trip Lifecycle: Prompts driver through sequential steps: Start Trip → Complete Trip.
  • Daily Earnings & Statistics: Tracks completed trips, shift hours, and revenue collected today (FR-30).
CampusGo Specification 4. Park Administrator Portal

4. Park Administrator Portal Core Functionalities

Park administrators oversee operational execution at their assigned terminal (Campus Gate Car Park or SUB Car Park), dispatch fleet departures, and act as operational proxies for drivers without smart mobile devices.

4.1 Terminal Operations & Non-Smart Driver Proxy (FR-05, FR-10, FR-36)

"On-Behalf" Driver Management (FR-05) Digital Inclusivity

Drivers without smartphones or internet access report physically to the park admin booth. The Park Admin checks them in, logs departures, and updates operational statuses on their behalf. The audit log explicitly attributes these updates as Updated by Admin on behalf of Driver (FR-10).

Cross-Park Departure & En-Route Marking (FR-15, FR-17) Transit Integrity

When a bus departs Campus Gate for SUB, the park admin marks the vehicle as En Route. This removes it from Campus Gate's available inventory without prematurely counting it as arrived at SUB until verified.

https://campus-go-7fcb.onrender.com (Park Admin Dashboard)
Screenshot 4: Park Admin Operations Command with scoped terminal queue metrics, check-in modals, and vehicle movement controls.

4.2 Disciplinary Actions (Park Admin Tier - FR-31)

  • Formal Disciplinary Warnings: Park Admins can issue formal written warnings with mandatory recorded reasons (e.g. queue jumping, fare disputes).
  • Capped 30-Day Suspension Authority: Park Admins may issue temporary operational suspensions strictly capped at 30 days. Indefinite or permanent suspensions require Central Admin escalation.

CampusGo Specification 6. Audit Trails & Disciplinary Architecture

6. Activity Auditing & Automated Disciplinary Engine

To guarantee accountability, every state transition in CampusGo is logged into an immutable audit trail, while disciplinary penalties are governed by an automated lifecycle engine.

6.1 Real-Time Activity Log (FR-10, FR-35, FR-36)

Every driver check-in, status adjustment, departure dispatch, disciplinary penalty, and record correction is captured with UTC timestamp and actor identity.

https://campus-go-7fcb.onrender.com (Central Admin Activity Log)
Screenshot 7: Real-time activity log showing granular audit entries for status updates, disciplinary penalties, and record corrections.

6.2 Disciplinary Authority Matrix & Automated Expiry (FR-31)

Disciplinary Action Park Admin Authority Central Admin Authority Automated Resolution
Issue Warning Yes (Mandatory reason required) Yes (Mandatory reason required) Permanent record on driver profile
Temporary Suspension Yes (Strictly capped at 1 to 30 days) Yes (Any duration) Auto-Expiry Engine: System automatically reinstates driver when suspension date elapses.
Indefinite Suspension No (Authority restricted) Yes (Full authority) Requires manual reactivation by Central Admin
Override / Revocation Cannot override Central decisions Can override or lift any Park Admin penalty Immediate restoration of driver access

7.2 Technical Optimizations & Architecture

Client-Side Image Compression (>97% Reduction) Performance

Implemented custom HTML5 Canvas image pre-processing (src/lib/imageCompression.ts) that automatically scales avatars to max 800px and 75% quality before upload. Reduces typical 5MB mobile photos to under 70KB, dramatically reducing mobile data usage on campus cellular networks.

Non-Blocking Toast Notification System Modern UX

Replaced intrusive native browser alert() popups with custom, animated, non-blocking toast notifications positioned at the bottom of the screen with smooth fade-out animations.

Zero-Auto-Login Session Security Security

New visitors land directly on the clean Sign In / Sign Up portal without defaulting into any user profile. Sessions persist in localStorage only while active, and logging out completely clears session tokens, requiring full re-authentication to enter the application.
